CANDIDATE (for judging fit only, do not contact anyone):
Prabhavit Gupta, based in Venice, Italy. Holds an Italian EU long-term residence permit, so he needs NO sponsorship anywhere in the EU. ~3 years professional experience, all in European startups, most recently Lead Developer at FlowSpace (remote, London company) Mar 2024 to Jul 2026, now available. BA Philosophy/International Studies/Economics, Ca' Foscari Venice — no CS degree. Languages: English professional, Hindi native, Italian beginner (so any role needing professional Italian/German/French/Dutch/Spanish is OUT).
He can evidence: shipped AI agents in production; grew FlowSpace from 2,000 to 4,500+ users; led a live migration from Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel; deep API integration work (Office RnD, Nexudus, Sendgrid, Google APIs, OpenAI/Anthropic, Eden AI); GTM/revenue automation and lead enrichment — unusual for an engineer and his strongest signal for client-facing technical roles; mediated between an internal team, an external agency and members, so he is genuinely customer-facing.

YOUR ARM: Track B — forward-deployed, solutions, implementation and client-facing technical roles. Also Track D — technical product management.

DISCOVERY (run searches in parallel in one message where you can, at least 9 distinct searches):
WebSearch with allowed_domains as a HARD host filter. Hosts: ["jobs.ashbyhq.com"], ["job-boards.greenhouse.io"], ["job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io"], ["jobs.smartrecruiters.com"], ["join.com"]
Queries:
- "forward deployed engineer" remote Europe
- solutions engineer AI remote EMEA
- implementation engineer SaaS remote Europe
- solutions architect AI mid-level remote Europe
- technical account manager AI automation remote EMEA
- sales engineer technical remote Europe SaaS
- "technical product manager" remote Europe AI
- AI product manager remote EMEA
- customer solutions engineer remote Europe

VERIFICATION — every row must come from a page you actually fetched:
- Normalise Ashby URLs to jobs.ashbyhq.com/<org>/<uuid> — strip ?embed=js, /application, ?utm_data=…, ?locationId=…
- An Ashby JS shell ("You need to enable JavaScript") means the FETCH failed, not that the role closed. Fall back to https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<org>?includeCompensation=true and ask a TARGETED question about the specific role. Never ask it to "list all jobs" — it truncates and fabricates negatives.
- Greenhouse: if a single-posting fetch returns MANY different jobs, the posting is CLOSED. Drop it.
- SmartRecruiters: use jobs.smartrecruiters.com, never careers.smartrecruiters.com (index pages only).
- Read the ELIGIBILITY SENTENCE, not the word "Remote" in the title.

DROP (hard gates): requires a language beyond English; ML research/PhD; staffing agencies, body shops and aggregators with no named end client (Jobgether especially); unpaid/equity-only/talent-pool listings; Staff/Principal/Head of/Director/people-managing Lead titles or 7+ years required; anything you cannot confirm is live.

RETURN: a JSON array ONLY, no prose around it. Each object:
{"company":"", "role":"", "url":"", "location_wording":"exact eligibility sentence from the page", "comp":"as stated or empty", "posted":"as stated or empty", "basis":"employment|contract", "stack":"named tools from the JD", "seniority":"years or level asked for", "why_fit":"one honest sentence tying it to his real experience", "watchouts":"honest risks"}

Aim for 10-18 verified roles. If you end up with fewer than 8, run a second discovery pass with different vocabulary before returning.
